title: numu CC coherent-like pi+ on CH (mu- + 1 pi+, no nucleons, |t|<0.125 GeV^2, 2<E_nu<20 GeV) dsigma/depi: pion energy E_pi [GeV]
motivation: Direct test of the v7 coherent pi+ model (Berger-Sehgal PCAC + Rein-Sehgal hadronic input above T_pi=1.7 GeV): mu- + one pi+ and no nucleons at low |t| on CH. The E_pi, theta_pi and E_nu dependence separate an underpredicted high-energy coherent cross section (hypothesis A) from a deficient incoherent low-Q2 DIS (hypothesis B) behind the low-pT/high-pz deficit of ccinc_2d and the forward-pion deficit of ccpip_thetapi; no corpus entry isolates coherent production.
